scope: Extend source-backed RASTERVARIABLES DXF allocation transaction evidence to matching AC1021 and AC1027 DWG/DXF profiles.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored DWG records generated during each test run
source.profile: One ACAD_IMAGE_VARS rooted RASTERVARIABLES object; a matching-version DWG is generated, imported into the adapter, and exported to ASCII and Binary DXF.

versionAttemptedButUnqualified.reason: The generated source did not pass current DWG class-integrity qualification; the DXF adapter refused output before allocation injection.

implementation.method: For each qualified source version and encoding, generate/import a matching-version DWG, calibrate the DXF export, inject std::bad_alloc at every measured callback allocation, require unchanged destination sentinel and caller source record, retry with the same adapter, compare bytes with clean output, and freshly read the typed raster variables graph.

validation.directControl: build-gcc/tests/libdxfrw_rastervariables_objects_allocation_tests /tmp/libdxfrw-rastervariables-source-version-matrix-2026-11-13: PASS for AC1021 and AC1027; ASCII 12 and Binary 11 offsets per version

limitations: Generated source data is locally authored; no independent producer interoperability or native consumer semantics are established.
AC1032 remains unqualified because its source failed class-integrity qualification and output was refused before allocation testing.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: Matching-source AC1021 and AC1027 RASTERVARIABLES export profiles pass allocation rollback, same-adapter retry, byte comparison, and typed readback.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue remaining public-writer route/variant inventory; keep AC1032 class-integrity, producer-profile, and consumer semantics open.
